match_nodes.description: Oregon SB 1546 — Artificial Intelligence Companion Chatbots

data.official_name: Oregon Senate Bill 1546 — Relating to Artificial Intelligence Companion Chatbots
data.description: Oregon statute regulating AI companion chatbots: mandates clear and recurring disclosure that the chatbot is artificially generated and not human, prohibits misrepresentation as a licensed health care provider, requires suicidal-ideation/self-harm crisis intervention and referral protocols, imposes heightened minor-safety protections, and provides both Attorney General enforcement and a private right of action.
data.notes: Status: Enacted in 2026; operative January 1, 2027 (passed during the 2026 Oregon Regular Legislative Session; verified as of 2026-11-03).
